experience in giving the effective Managed services to the end customers and keeping the high customer satisfaction without any glitch throughout the career.

Demonstrated experience in getting the Business from channel partners.
Proven ability to manage stakeholders across all levels.
Strong experience in resource planning, allocation, utilization, and attrition management.
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to translate a vaguely defined business problem into analytical solution framework.

Rich experience and Expertise in Avaya Technologies
Strong Experience of AWS cloud Contact Center Technology (Amazon Connect), in Presales, Solution Designing, Customer presentation, Requirement Gathering, Project Management, UAT, Training and Go-live Support to premium customers across Globe.

Experienced professional in Genesys Pure Cloud.

sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
Professional Highlights
Feb’24 – Present: Started own venture in Investment Consulting. Taken Agency Mentorships (Distributorship) for Major Mutual Fund AMC’s, Life and Health Insurance Companies of India.
Life Insurance: LIC, HDFC Life and Bajaj Allianz Life Insurance
Health Insurance: Niva Bupa and Care Health Insurance
Oct’21 – Jan’24: Tecnomic Systems, as Global Delivery Head – Contact Center Technologies
Key Accounts: Singlife with AVIVA, Manulife and Netlink Trust
Complete Timely delivery of new Projects (i.e., Requirement Gathering, Scope of Work finalization, complete Project Management to Service Delivery, SIT, UAT and Solution Training).
Work with the global sales team for making the deals finalized (i.e. getting the exact need of the customer, Solution designing, Solution presentation, getting customers queries addressed, Quotation, convincing customer for deal closure).
Work on the new RFP’s along with sales team right from analyzing the requirement, Solution design, Compliance assessment, Business proposal and customer presentation.
Cross Selling in the existing account
Technical presentation to Customers
End to End Client Management (i.e., Solution Designing, Presentation, Requirement Gathering, Scope of Work, complete Project Management to Service Delivery).
Work with inhouse back-end development team for the timely project delivery.
Manage Service Operations
Front Ending customers Escalations and resolving their queries and doubts
Customer and Internal Team’sTraining
Design and implement plan to improve customer experience
Work with customer and internal teams in multiple time zone
Finalizing the SLAs with the customer and managing the same
Getting the Agreed SLAs of customer managed by the Partners
Mar’10 – Dec’18: Blackbox Ltd. (Formerly known as AGC Networks Ltd.) Gurgaon, as Service Delivery Manager – Key Accounts
Jan’19 – Sept’20: Blackbox Ltd., Gurgaon, as Manager –Technical Consulting
Key Accounts: Genpact, American Express, TCS, Fidelity, ITC, Concentrix, BMW, JW Marriot, Max Newyork Life Insurance, Ciena, Starwood, Fiserv, Quatro, Hindustan Zinc, Religare, JLL, EXL, Canara HSBC, Apollo Munich, Metlife etc.
Single point of contact for assigned national level accounts.
Responsible for the End-to-End problem resolution of Key Accounts (Related to Service Delivery, Project Implementation, New Solutions, Sales and Logistics) of AGC Networks in Northern Region.
Troubleshooting of the escalated calls of Avaya products (Avaya CM, AES, CMS, AAEP, SBC, System Manager, Session Manager, one-x Agent, Messaging, AWFO, IP Office, ACR etc.) of the customers in the NR region.
Coordinating with OEM’s (Avaya, Nice, Verint, Cube, Polycom, Oracle, Nuance and Nector) to get the problems resolved with-in defined SLA, to have the minimal business impact.
Technical support to Engineers and training of Avaya Products to the new Recruits.
Annual AMC finalization with customers and convince them to get the payment released.
Responsible to generate business from Key Accounts.
Manage customer Relationships, drive customer satisfaction and Deliver revenue figures.
Proactive knowledge-transfer sessions and regular product updates to key customers.
Share Product & Technology Roadmap with the customers.
Understand customer’s requirements and to provide them technically the best and the cost-effective solution.
Solution presentations to the customers and business partners.
Preparing Solution Documents and Bill of Material for the proposed solution.
Develop new Accounts for which received the lead from OEM / marketing team, understand their business requirements, translate the same into technology need & convert it in Sales.
Impart Technology Updates & Product knowledge to Sales and Business Development community in the organization.
Arrange for Proof of Concept for the solution proposed to the customer.
Closely work with marketing function to work out attractive bundled packages to the customers.
May’07 – Mar’10: Bank of America (Formerly known as BA Continuum Solutions) as Assistant Manager - Technology
Responsible for the complete Voice Network (Avaya) of the organization across the three Locations (Gurgaon, Hyderabad, and Mumbai) in INDIA
Planning and Implementation of Business Transitions / Migrations (Upcoming projects), in terms of Voice Infrastructure and Call routing.
Capacity planning of Voice Infrastructure for the upcoming transitions
Coordinating with the Centralized Network team, for the proper functioning of the Banks Network.
Grooming team members, by imparting technical expertise to handle bigger roles.
Coordinating with Vendors to get problems resolved within defined SLA’s.
Negotiations with Vendors on new requirements and AMC finalization
Jan’05 – May’07: Avaya Global Connect Ltd., as Engineer- Regional Services team
Responsible for Implementation and Maintenance of Avaya Definity PBXs (G3 series), Media Servers (S8xxx series) and Gateways, Voice messaging systems (Intuity, Modular Messaging), CMS / BCMS reporting systems, Logger, IVR, Call billing Software’s, Dialer Integration etc.
Responsible for the Onsite and Remote support to the customer in terms of changes required to be done in the configuration.
Advanced level of Technical Trainings to customers.
Worked on systems/technologies like HP-Unix, Sun Solaris, CTI and IP.
Technical support to Engineers and training of Avaya Products to the new Recruits.
Handled Key accounts in Gurgaon like American Express, IBM Daksh, GE SBI, IGT, TCS, PGCIL, Bank of America, RMS, Accenture, India Bulls, VDML, RBS, ABN AMRO Bank, ITC, Sapient, Ranbaxy, Aviva Life Insurance etc
Previous Experiences
